messages:
Maya R: heads up, deploybot started staged rollout of runtime-engine v2.1.3-quant-opt to prod-eu
deploy-bot: started rollout v2.1.3-quant-opt -> regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1, us-east-1; stage=1/5
Liam C: saw small spike in kernel OOMs in canary last hour, telemetry flagged nvlink driver mismatch on eu-west-1
Maya R: thanks. can we pin eu-west-1 to previous engine until we investigate?
Andrew P: +1. Recommend pin eu-west-1 to v2.1.2 for now. Keep other regions progressing.
Nina S: looking at logs now, root cause looks like driver 515 vs 520 mismatch on older nodes. i'll confirm node ids.
Liam C: if we pin, what happens to in-flight requests? any downtime?
Maya R: deploybot supports per-region pin. no traffic drop, just will route new allocations to pinned image. existing instances keep serving.
Andrew P: deploybot command: `/deploybot pin region eu-west-1 --service runtime-engine --version v2.1.2 --reason "nvlink-driver mismatch"`
Maya R: can someone run that once Nina confirms node list? I can run post-pin smoke.
Nina S: confirmed node ids: node-eu-12, node-eu-13 showing driver 515. I'll annotate infra ticket.
Nina S: infra ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9823 created, adding driver bump plan.
deploy-bot: note: pin operation requires approval from eng-sre when active rollouts >1 regions.
Liam C: pinging @eng-sre for quick ack. @Jules S can you approve?
Jules S: approving. do the pin and then mark for rollback window if needed.
Maya R: performing pin now.
Maya R: `/deploybot pin-region eu-west-1 runtime-engine v2.1.2 --by maya.r --ticket INF-9823`
deploy-bot: region pin queued, started. expected complete in ~2m
deploy-bot: region pin complete for eu-west-1 -> v2.1.2
Maya R: running smoke: small gen and kv-cache smoke. all green so far.
Liam C: telemetry confirms kernel OOMs dropped to 0 in eu-west-1 post-pin.
Andrew P: ok, continue rollout in other regions but add a hold at stage=3 for 30m.
Maya R: set hold: `/deploybot set-hold --rollout-id 12345 --stage 3 --duration 30m`
deploy-bot: hold set on rollout 12345 stage 3 by maya.r
Nina S: I'll prepare driver bump PR and coordinate with infra for a rolling reboot; target maintenance window tonight 22:00 UTC.
Maya R: add a blurb to release notes: "v2.1.3-quant-opt: Kernel optimizations + quantization improvements. Hotfix: pin in eu-west-1 due to driver mismatch; infra working on driver rollouts." keep it short.
Andrew P: I'll update release notes and add rollback criteria: >error-rate >1% sustained for 10m OR >5% crash rate 5m.
Maya R: thanks. will monitor. escalate if metrics trend.
Liam C: happy path: redeploy v2.1.3 after infra driver bump and run canary again.
Maya R: thanks team :thumbsup:
